purpose: Deterministic benchmark fixtures for FoodScan AI food recognition and nutrition invariants. These are reference expectations, not claims about live model accuracy.

mealCases.input: 2 rotis + 1 bowl dal + 1 bowl cooked rice

nutritionInvariants: saturatedFat must not exceed total fat
meal totals must equal the sum of normalized item nutrition
identitySafety: barcode data must not override a conflicting visible package identity
approved corrections may change identity fields only
correction-derived nutrition, ingredients, allergens and additives must not be copied
